0.1.name: code_search
0.1.description: Code-search domain prior: match a code snippet to the natural-language summary that describes its functionality.

0.5.name: code_artifact_type
0.5.description: Type of code unit being summarized, such as a function, method, class, or code block.

2.0.name: control_data_flow
2.0.description: Core control- and data-flow structure that links the code's behavior to its natural-language description.

4.0.name: signature_attribute
4.0.description: Discriminative signature attributes: argument list, types, and return shape that characterize the function.

6.0.name: module_context
6.0.description: Surrounding module/class context and imports needed to interpret the code's purpose.

10.0.name: nl_summary
10.0.description: Natural-language summary describing what the code does; the main content axis aligning code and docstring.

12.0.name: code_function
12.0.description: The function/code body being matched against its summary; the retrieval evidence.

18.0.name: input_parameters
18.0.description: Input parameters/arguments consumed by the function.

19.0.name: return_value
19.0.description: Return value or output produced by the function.

24.0.name: api_call
24.0.description: Named API calls, library functions, or operations invoked in the code body.

30.0.name: function_and_identifier_names
30.0.description: Function name plus variable/identifier names; the discriminative signal that separates topically-similar code.

40.0.name: code_body_tokens
40.0.description: High-detail implementation tokens of the code body: operators, literals, and statement-level specifics.

50.0.name: intent_rationale
50.0.description: Reasoning that maps the natural-language intent to the chosen implementation and code structure.

70.0.name: language_label
70.0.description: Programming language or task category of the code artifact, such as Python, Java, Go, or PHP.
